verdict.rationale: The evidence shows call routing to people, custom ring orders, call transfers, phone menus, mobile apps, and Sona answering when the team can't. None of it documents forwarding the business number to an external cell phone, or doing so conditionally when the team is away. These are adjacent call-routing features, not the forwarding capability itself, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
